title: Letters and Garden
author: K. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Astrid Thackeray, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
